[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

Fixes #43746.

#43691 added `self._shard_modulation` to `QwenImageTransformerBlock.__init__`, and made `_get_modulation_params()` read it unconditionally. `TestQwenImageModulationCache._block()` in `test/registered/kernels/ops/diffusion/test_model_fast_paths.py` builds the block with `__new__` and skips `__init__`. So all four tests in the class fail with `AttributeError: 'QwenImageTransformerBlock' object has no attribute '_shard_modulation'`. That fails `jit-kernel-unit-test-1-gpu-large` in `PR Test Base`, for example in [this job](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38193715150/job/114634289012) on #43104.

## Modifications

- In the test helper `_block()`, set `block._shard_modulation = False`. This is the replicated, non-TP layout that the single-GPU `_CountingProjection` stubs model, and it matches the behavior from before #43691. This is a one-line, test-only change.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This is a test-only change.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (This fixes an existing unit test. I couldn't run it locally because it needs a CUDA GPU; the `jit-kernel` CI suite will confirm.)
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not needed.)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Not applicable.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
